speaker: 志偉
source_cantonese: 詩敏，你飲咖啡定奶茶好啲？
source_jyutping: /si1 man5, nei5 jam2 gaa3 fe1 ding6 naai5 caa4 hou2 di1?/

speaker: 詩敏
source_cantonese: 我鍾意飲奶茶多啲。你呢？
source_jyutping: /ngo5 zung1 ji3 jam2 naai5 caa4 do1 di1. nei5 ne1?/

speaker: 志偉
source_cantonese: 我都係鍾意奶茶。點解呀？
source_jyutping: /ngo5 dou1 hai6 zung1 ji3 naai5 caa4. dim2 gaai2 aa3?/

speaker: 詩敏
source_cantonese: 因為奶茶香啲，你覺得呢？
source_jyutping: /jan1 wai6 naai5 caa4 hoeng1 di1, nei5 gok3 dak1 ne1?/

speaker: 志偉
source_cantonese: 我同意。咁凍飲定熱飲好？
source_jyutping: /ngo5 tung4 ji3. gam2 dung3 jam2 ding6 jit6 jam2 hou2?/

speaker: 詩敏
source_cantonese: 我鍾意凍飲，特別係夏天。
source_jyutping: /ngo5 zung1 ji3 dung3 jam2, dak6 bit6 hai6 haa6 tin1./

speaker: 志偉
source_jyutping: /daan6 hai6 ji4 gaa1 dung1 tin1 wo3, gam2 dim2?/

speaker: 詩敏
source_cantonese: 噢，咁熱飲好啲。你去邊度買？
source_jyutping: /o5, gam2 jit6 jam2 hou2 di1. nei5 heoi3 bin1 dou6 maai5?/

speaker: 志偉
source_jyutping: /ngo5 tung1 soeng4 heoi3 caa4 caan1 teng1. nei5 ne1?/

speaker: 詩敏
source_jyutping: /ngo5 zung1 ji3 heoi3 lin4 so2 dim3 do1 di1./

speaker: 志偉
source_jyutping: /dim2 gaai2 aa3? lin4 so2 dim3 hou2 di1?/

speaker: 詩敏
source_jyutping: /ngo5 gok3 dak1 faai3 di1, nei5 gok3 dak1 ne1?/

speaker: 志偉
source_jyutping: /dou1 hai6. daan6 hai6 caa4 caan1 teng1 peng4 di1./

speaker: 志偉
source_jyutping: /peng4 ng5 man1 zo2 jau6. gam2 sik6 faan6 ne1?/

speaker: 詩敏
source_jyutping: /nei5 zung1 ji3 zung1 caan1 ding6 sai1 caan1?/

speaker: 志偉
source_jyutping: /ngo5 loeng5 joeng6 dou1 zung1 ji3. nei5 ne1?/

speaker: 詩敏
source_cantonese: 我鍾意中餐多啲，好味啲。
source_jyutping: /ngo5 zung1 ji3 zung1 caan1 do1 di1, hou2 mei6 di1./

speaker: 志偉
source_jyutping: /gam2 nei5 zung1 ji3 jyut6 coi3 ding6 cyun1 coi3?/

speaker: 詩敏
source_cantonese: 粵菜好啲，我唔係好鍾意辣。
source_jyutping: /jyut6 coi3 hou2 di1, ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 zung1 ji3 laat6./

speaker: 志偉
source_cantonese: 我就鍾意辣嘅。咁返工呢？
source_jyutping: /ngo5 zau6 zung1 ji3 laat6 ge3. gam2 faan1 gung1 ne1?/

speaker: 詩敏
source_jyutping: /daap3 baa1 si2 ding6 dei6 tit3 hou2 di1?/

speaker: 志偉
source_jyutping: /dei6 tit3 faai3 di1, daan6 hai6 gwai3 di1./

speaker: 詩敏
source_jyutping: /ngo5 gok3 dak1 dei6 tit3 syu1 fuk6 di1./

speaker: 志偉
source_jyutping: /nei5 hai6 m4 hai6 jat6 jat6 daap3 dei6 tit3?/

speaker: 詩敏
source_jyutping: /hai6 aa3, nei5 ne1? nei5 dim2 faan1 gung1?/

speaker: 志偉
source_jyutping: /ngo5 jau5 si4 haang4 lou6, jau5 si4 daap3 ce1./

speaker: 志偉
source_cantonese: 十五分鐘左右。咁買嘢呢？
source_jyutping: /sap6 ng5 fan1 zung1 zo2 jau6. gam2 maai5 je5 ne1?/

speaker: 詩敏
source_jyutping: /nei5 zung1 ji3 heoi3 soeng1 coeng4 ding6 gaai1 si5?/

speaker: 志偉
source_jyutping: /soeng1 coeng4 fong1 bin6 di1, gon1 zeng6 di1./

speaker: 詩敏
source_jyutping: /daan6 hai6 gaai1 si5 san1 sin1 di1, peng4 di1./

speaker: 志偉
source_jyutping: /hai6 wo3. gam2 nei5 zau1 mut6 zou6 me1?/

speaker: 詩敏
source_jyutping: /ngo5 zung1 ji3 tai2 hei3. nei5 ne1?/

speaker: 志偉
source_jyutping: /ngo5 zung1 ji3 zou6 wan6 dung6 do1 di1./

speaker: 志偉
source_cantonese: 跑步同游水。你有冇做運動？
source_jyutping: /paau2 bou6 tung4 jau4 seoi2. nei5 jau5 mou5 zou6 wan6 dung6?/

speaker: 詩敏
source_cantonese: 有時行山，但係唔係好多。
source_jyutping: /jau5 si4 haang4 saan1, daan6 hai6 m4 hai6 hou2 do1./

speaker: 志偉
source_jyutping: /haang4 saan1 dou1 hou2 aa3, hung1 hei3 hou2 di1./

to take a look, let's see
